question: The angles of a triangle are (8x - 15)°,(6x - 11)° and ( 4x – 10)°. What is the value of x ?
solution:
**Given:**

The angles of a triangle are (8x - 15)°,(6x - 11)°, and ( 4x – 10)°

**Concept used:**

The sum of three angles of a triangle = 180°

**Calculation:**

(8x - 15) + (6x - 11) + ( 4x – 10) = 180

⇒ 8x - 15 + 6x - 11 + 4x – 10 = 180

⇒ 18x - 36 = 180

⇒ 18x = 180 + 36 = 216

⇒ x = 216/18 = 12

**∴ The value of x is 12°**
